answer: This gate blocks bulk fake identities at registration. Each applicant must compute a sequential delay proof whose kernel is one hash chain tied to its public key, impossible to split across machines. The proof is published as a comet trail any peer verifies in seconds. Only then does the registry anchor the identity to it, so 1,000 puppets cost 1,000 sequential hours, while one honest agent pays one hour once and keeps its full reward share.
